verified_examples.why: 83,699 - 3,658 - 54,842 = 25,199 on the page. The linkbase flattens Total revenue into net interest income + noninterest income; the graph uses the printed subtotal.
-592 + -355 = -947 on the page. The linkbase declares the net change as operating + investing + financing + FX + cash held for sale; the graph checked the last step of the same reconciliation.

The 14 printed lines add to 11,739. The linkbase has the same 14 children, one a company extension (cat_NonCashGainLossOnDivestiture); the measurement mapped that 30 to a us-gaap element that holds the same amount.

159,128 + 14,295 + 8,687 = 182,110. The linkbase lists the same three lines (CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold, OperatingCostsAndExpenses, SG&A); the conflict is measurement noise, two lines unmapped and one value coincidence.
184,432 + 3,000 + 1,599 = 189,031. The linkbase lists the same three lines, two as company extensions the measurement could not map.
5,942 - 262 - 127 = 5,553. The graph keeps the two printed NCI lines; the linkbase declares one combined NCI element (389).
352,229 + 53,380 + 38,038 + 3,920 = 447,567. The linkbase has one aggregate revenue element for products + services (91,418) that is not a printed line.
The eight printed fees add to 36,215. The linkbase groups three of them under one contract-revenue element that is not printed.
54,253 + 19,637 = 73,890. End cash = start cash + change is a roll-forward; the linkbase's only relation for that element is cash + restricted cash in a reconciliation note.
292,455 + 112,093 = 404,548. The linkbase also lists Commitments and contingencies, a line with no amount.
The seven printed lines add to 22,762; the linkbase has seven children, two of them an extension and a deposit-liability element the measurement mapped to a same-valued asset element.
